rationale: Rule-made from delivery-045: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. photo-evidence-433.txt is mentioned but missing from the case; the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
